resources.string: No selected document has OCR text for Word export
%1$d selected document(s) do not have OCR text yet. Start OCR now so they can be exported as Word documents.
OCR is already running. Wait until it finishes before starting another Word export.
Exports stored OCR text as an editable Word document (.docx). Layout and images are not recreated; use Searchable PDF when you need the original PDF appearance.
Word export creates editable DOCX files from stored OCR text. The export is text-only and keeps documents local until you save, share, or export them.
